lines.en: label mayaspring2:
scene clearnightsky
I can count the amount of “dates” I went on with {i}my{/i} Maya on one hand. Though I’m not sure she’d call them that if she were still here today.
lines.zh: 我和{i}我的{/i} Maya 约过的"约会"，一只手就数得过来。不过她要是今天还在，我怀疑她不会管那些叫约会。

lines.en: Since she’s not, though, I feel as if I can safely label that night at the takoyaki stand as our first without incurring any more ghostly wrath than I already do on a nightly basis.
lines.zh: 可既然她不在了，我觉得我可以放心地把在章鱼烧摊前的那个晚上称作我们的第一次，而不必再招来比我已经每晚都要承受的更多的亡灵之怒。

lines.en: Come to think of it, a second haunting might be nice — even if I doubt Maya and Sekai would get along very well.
lines.zh: 想想看，再来一次闹鬼也许也不错——尽管我怀疑 Maya 和 Sekai 会相处得不太好。

lines.en: They wouldn’t need to, though. I’m sure I could figure out how to ration my time in between the secret resurrection studies I’ve been partaking in behind your back.
lines.zh: 不过她们也不需要相处。我肯定能想出办法，在我背着你偷偷进行的那些复活研究之间把时间匀开。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of time now. Not until I succeed — until I become one of them. And there’s no longer any need to study at all.
lines.zh: 现在只是时间问题了。不是到我成功为止——是到我成为她们其中之一为止。到那时就再也不需要研究了。

lines.en: But it’s precisely {i}because{/i} it’s a matter of time that I feel confident when I tell you it is so far away that you’ll likely be gone before I reach it.
lines.zh: 但也正{i}因为{/i}这是时间问题，我才有信心告诉你：那一天远得很，很可能我还没走到，你就已经不在了。

lines.en: And {i}I{/i} probably won’t remember ever telling you this at all.
lines.zh: 而{i}我{/i}大概根本不会记得自己跟你说过这些。

lines.en: scene black
There’s a hand to my side that doesn’t belong to me.
lines.zh: 我身侧有一只不属于我的手。

lines.en: It keeps brushing up against mine as if it’s asking for something — but it’s an unwelcome sensation that does little but annoy me and cause me to move aside by half a step.
lines.zh: 它不停地蹭着我的手，像是在讨要什么——但这是一种不受欢迎的感觉，除了惹恼我、让我往旁边挪半步之外没什么用。

lines.en: Not enough to make it obvious that I’m rejecting it, but enough {i}to{/i} reject it while still leaving room for a little wishful thinking to fill her thoughts in place of my appendage.
lines.zh: 不足以明显到让人看出我在拒绝，却又足够{i}拒绝{/i}它，同时留出一点余地，让她用一厢情愿的想象去填补我那只手的位置。

lines.en: This is only our second first-date after all. It’s only right to wait at least one more before we touch.
lines.zh: 毕竟这只是我们第二次的第一次约会。再等一次再碰她也是应该的。

lines.en: Which ignores all of the angry, begrudging sex I have already had with her. But that’s something {i}else{/i} I’m trying to look past too.
lines.zh: 这话忽略了我早就跟她做过的那些气急败坏、勉为其难的性事。但那也是我正在努力翻篇的{i}另一件{/i}事。

lines.en: I just won’t know what sorts of wonders a second first-fuck will be until after the second first-date.
lines.zh: 只是，在第二次的第一次约会结束之前，我不会知道第二次的第一次做爱会是什么奇景。

lines.en: But will a second first-box and the encroaching second first-meal we’ll share dilute or distort any of these new memories to the point where keeping them isn’t worth the risk?
lines.zh: 可是，第二次"第一次"的盒子，还有紧随而来的我们要共享的第二次"第一次"的一餐，会不会把这些新记忆稀释或扭曲到——不值得冒险留下它们的程度？

lines.en: I wonder if she asked herself the same thing when {i}she{/i} was taking me here?
lines.zh: 我不知道{i}她{/i}当初带我来这儿的时候，有没有问过自己同样的问题。

lines.en: How annoying it is to have the roles reversed.
lines.zh: 角色对调过来真是烦人。

lines.en: No wonder why she was always so angry.
lines.zh: 难怪她以前总是那么生气。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain1
: Do you want anything?
lines.zh: : 你想要点什么吗？

lines.en: : You mean you’ll let me buy myself food with my own money?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你肯让我用自己的钱给自己买吃的？

lines.en: : I think I’m supposed to. That seems like proper date etiquette to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我应该这么做。这对我来说才像是正经的约会礼仪。

lines.en: The old man behind the counter grunts. I doubt I’ll ever hear anything else from him.
lines.zh: 柜台后面的老头哼了一声。我怀疑我不可能再从他嘴里听到别的话了。

lines.en: : We could also go out to a restaurant instead if you’d rather-
lines.zh: : 我们也可以改去餐厅，如果你更想——

lines.en: : No. It has to be here.
lines.zh: : 不。必须在这儿。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain2
: {i}Has{/i} to? Why does it {i}have{/i} to be here?
lines.zh: : {i}必须{/i}？为什么{i}必须{/i}在这儿？

lines.en: The old man grunts again.
lines.zh: 老头又哼了一声。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain3
: And why does he keep doing that?
lines.zh: : 他为什么一直这样？

lines.en: : It’s how he communicates, I think. Like Yasu with her incessant ramblings about God and...{i}old{/i} Maya with her incessant ramblings about how disgusting I am.
lines.zh: : 我想这就是他的沟通方式。就像 Yasu 没完没了地念叨上帝，还有……{i}旧{/i} Maya 没完没了地念叨我有多恶心。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain4
: She had a point. You {i}are{/i} pretty disgusting.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。你{i}确实{/i}挺恶心的。

lines.en: : Don’t say that line. You haven’t earned it yet.
lines.zh: : 别用这句台词。你还没挣到资格。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain5
: Are you seriously telling me I have to earn the right to say my own lines? Because I get being enamored, but this is just sad.
lines.zh: : 你是认真的吗？说我自己写过的台词还得挣资格？被人迷得神魂颠倒我理解，可这也太可悲了。

lines.en: : Then, to even the playing field, I hereby grant you permission to ban me from saying one thing {i}your{/i} version of me frequently said to you. That way, we’ll both be happy.
lines.zh: : 那为了公平起见，我在此准许你禁止我说一句{i}你的{/i}那个我常对你说的话。这样我们俩都高兴。

lines.en: : Great. Then I hereby ban you from saying “no.” Would you like to go fornicate behind a tree now?
lines.zh: : 好。那我在此禁止你说"不"。现在要不要去树后面交配？

lines.en: : No.
: You bastard. You’ve already broken the rules.
lines.zh: : 你这个混蛋。你已经犯规了。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain6
: This agreement was voided from the get-go since there’s basically no way I’d have ever said “no” to you to begin with.
lines.zh: : 这份协议从一开始就是无效的，因为打从一开始我基本上就不可能对你说"不"。

lines.en: : I’m sure it happened once or twice.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定总发生过一两次。

lines.en: The old man grunts again, this time with slightly more fervor or feeling than before.
lines.zh: 老头又哼了一声，这次比之前多了几分热忱或者说感情。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain7
: Oh. I guess we should probably order.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我们大概该点单了。

lines.en: : That is what we’re supposed to do here, yes. But it’s not like this guy has anything else going on. He probably enjoys the-
lines.zh: : 我们来这儿本来就该点单，是的。不过这家伙又没别的事可做。他大概很享受——

lines.en: Another grunt. Something tells me I will die after the next.
lines.zh: 又一声哼。有种预感告诉我，下一声之后我就要死了。

lines.en: : Just give us the usual please.
lines.zh: : 请给我们来老样子。

lines.en: : There’s only one thing on the menu. I think this is more of a {i}quantity{/i} problem than him not knowing what to give us.
lines.zh: : 菜单上只有一样东西。我觉得这是{i}数量{/i}问题，不是他不知道该给我们什么。

lines.en: : Then — enough to feed five to ten girls, please.
lines.zh: : 那么——请给我们够五到十个女孩吃的份量。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain8
: You’re not planning on inviting others, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会打算把别人也请来吧？

lines.en: : No. I just know you well and don’t feel like spending enough to feed {i}twenty{/i} girls. Ten seemed like a fair compromise.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是很了解你，又不想花够养活{i}二十个{/i}女孩的钱。十个听起来是个公平的折中。

lines.en: : How very kind of you. Perhaps once we’re done, I’ll let you fornicate with me behind a tree completely free of charge.
lines.zh: : 您真是太体贴了。也许等我们吃完，我会让你免费在树后面跟我交配一次。

lines.en: : Are you a prostitute now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是妓女了？

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain9
: Yes. Please hurry, takoyaki man. I’m a poor high school girl and I need to go have sex with this adult man for money.
lines.zh: : 是的。请快点，章鱼烧大叔。我是个贫穷的高中女生，我需要去跟这个成年男人做爱换钱。

lines.en: : I’d be worried if I wasn’t partially convinced this guy is actually a robot.
lines.zh: : 要不是我有点相信这家伙其实是个机器人，我都要担心了。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain10
: {i}I’m{/i} not entirely convinced that we’re {i}all{/i} not actually robots. And that our whole lives are some weird simulation about AI obtaining actual intelligence or something.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}甚至不能完全确定我们其实{i}都{/i}不是机器人。也许我们整个人生都是某种关于 AI 获得真正智能的奇怪模拟什么的。

lines.en: : My Maya’s theories were way better than that. And that’s saying a lot since practically all of them were wrong.
lines.zh: : 我的 Maya 的理论可比这个强多了。而且这话说得很有分量，因为那些理论几乎全是错的。

lines.en: : I take great offense to this. If there is anything I know about myself, it is that I am always right. And if there is anything I know about you-
lines.zh: : 这话我听了非常生气。如果说我对自己有什么了解，那就是我永远是对的。而如果我对——

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain11
A fifth grunt from the old man. This is where I die.
lines.zh: 老头的第五声哼。我要死在这儿了。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain12
Or perhaps just relocate to a bench to continue feeding into the undeniable yet tragically painful chemistry I have with this creature.
lines.zh: 或者干脆挪到长椅上，继续喂养我和这个生物之间那份不可否认、却又痛苦得要命的化学反应。

lines.en: For it truly feels as if we have known each other forever. But {i}this{/i} forever has only lasted a little over a year.
lines.zh: 因为真的感觉我们像是认识了一辈子。可{i}这个{/i}"一辈子"只持续了一年多一点。

lines.en: And while that’s more than many get, it’s hard to say it feels like {i}anything{/i} when I never thought that Maya was going to leave {i}me{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: 虽然那已经比许多人得到的要多，但当我从一开始就没想过 Maya 会离开{i}我{/i}的时候，很难说这算{i}什么{/i}感觉。

lines.en: Even {i}with{/i} all of the warnings that are now...racing back to me in hindsight.
lines.zh: 即便那些如今……事后才纷纷涌回我脑海的警告都{i}在{/i}。

lines.en: That isn’t {i}all{/i} that’s racing back, though. There’s hope, too. There’s-
lines.zh: 不过涌回来的{i}不只是{/i}那些。还有希望。还有——

lines.en: : Feed me.
lines.zh: : 喂我。

lines.en: : Feed me and I’ll let you fornicate with me behind a tree.
lines.zh: : 喂我，我就让你在树后面跟我交配。

lines.en: : What is it with you and this tree thing all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你这是怎么了，突然老惦记树的事？

lines.en: : I don’t really know. The first time was just a joke but, the more I say it, the more it sounds kind of fun.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。第一次只是个玩笑，但我说得越多，听起来就越好玩。

lines.en: : You can also just feed me without the promise of sex, though. Anything to get those hot balls inside of my mouth.
lines.zh: : 不过你也可以不带性承诺地喂我。只要能把那些热乎乎的丸子送进我嘴里，怎么样都行。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think this date thing was actually a bad idea after all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得约会这事儿果然还是个坏主意。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain13
: Fine. Then you leave me no choice but to revert to my {i}former{/i} self since {i}that{/i} is the one you have apparently decided to latch onto.
lines.zh: : 好。那你逼得我别无选择，只能退回我{i}从前{/i}的样子，因为显然你已经决定要抓住{i}那个{/i}样子不放。

lines.en: : Assuming of course that a man of your supreme idiocy and undeniable general grossness is capable of latching onto any {i}one{/i} thing to begin with.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你这种愚蠢至极、又无可否认地令人作呕的男人，从一开始就有能力抓住某{i}一样{/i}东西不放。

lines.en: : Which implies, of course, that I believe I’d be extremely well fed if only I was an entire group of teenagers rather than just one unfortunate, yet immensely adorable girl.
lines.zh: : 这也就是说，我当然相信，只要我是一整群少女、而不是一个不幸却无比可爱的女孩，我就会被喂得极好。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain14
: Fine. I’ll feed you so long as it gets you to stop trying to be {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好。我喂你，只要你别再试着当{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : Wait. Now I’m confused. Don’t you {i}want{/i} me to be her? Isn’t that your entire goal in talking to me again?
lines.zh: : 等等。这下我糊涂了。你不是{i}想{/i}让我成为她吗？你重新跟我说话，不就是为了这个？

lines.en: : It’s...a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 这……比那个要复杂一点。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain15
: I’m very interested in whatever that might possibly mean. But I’m also very hungry and I don’t know which feeling to prioritize.
lines.zh: : 我对那可能是什么意思非常感兴趣。但我也非常饿，不知道该优先顾哪一头。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain16
: Well you can take your time if- oh. I guess you’ve already figured it out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你可以慢慢来，如果——哦。看来你已经想好了。

lines.en: : Food now, talk later. I have made up my mind.
lines.zh: : 先吃饭，后说话。我下定决心了。

lines.en: : At least we know there’s no food in those mysterious boxes since I imagine you would have found a way to tear them open earlier.
lines.zh: : 至少我们知道那些神秘的盒子里没有食物，因为我想你早就想办法把它们撕开了。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaah~
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊~

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain17
: Aaaaaaaahhhhh~
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊~

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain18
: AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Sorry. This just...feels really weird.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是……这感觉真的很奇怪。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain19
: To be completely honest, I agree. We’re being so cute right now that I imagine we must look like an actual couple.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我同意。我们现在可爱到我都觉得我们看起来像一对真正的情侣。

lines.en: : I think you’re doing the heavy lifting in the cuteness department. I’m kind of just...here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可爱这部分主要是你在出力。我有点只是……在这儿而已。

lines.en: : True. I didn’t want to be the one to say it, though.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过我不想当那个说出口的人。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain20
: But on the bright side, at least being next to me makes you look better.
lines.zh: : 但从好的方面看，至少待在我身边显得你更好看。

lines.en: : Or {i}worse{/i} when you’re telling strangers that I’m paying you to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 或者{i}更糟{/i}——当你跟陌生人说是我付钱让你跟我上床的时候。

lines.en: : Doubtful. A girl like me could bring in a lot of money, Sensei. People might think you’re rich if I keep telling them that.
lines.zh: : 未必。我这样的姑娘能赚不少钱呢，Sensei。我要是一直这么说，别人说不定会以为你很有钱。

lines.en: : It’s a vast departure from that whole “pretend we don’t know or like each other” thing. But hey, I got used to that and I can get used to this too.
lines.zh: : 这跟那套"假装我们不认识、也不喜欢对方"差得可远了。不过嘿，那套我都习惯了，这套我也能习惯。

lines.en: : Did I...{i}really{/i} make you do that?
lines.zh: : 我……{i}真的{/i}让你做过那种事吗？

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain21
: Well...yeah. It’s not like you forced it on me, though. It was my idea.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。不过也不是你强加给我的。那是我的主意。

lines.en: : But why would you-
lines.zh: : 可你为什么——

lines.en: : It’s just easier that way. You don’t have to deal with people knowing your proclivities and {i}I{/i} don’t have to deal with a parade of teenagers also trying to bone you.
lines.zh: : 只是那样比较省事。你不必应付别人知道你那些癖好，{i}我{/i}也不必应付一队也想跟你上床的少女。

lines.en: : You mostly just mean Ami, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你基本只是在说 Ami，对吧？

lines.en: : I mostly just mean Ami, yes.
lines.zh: : 我基本只是在说 Ami，是的。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain22
: But now {i}she{/i} knows fucking everything ever and you’re {i}fucking{/i} everyone ever, so...why bother continuing to handicap myself?
lines.zh: : 可现在{i}她{/i}什么他妈的事都知道了，而你也他妈的跟所有人都{i}上床{/i}了，所以……我何必继续给自己上枷锁呢？

lines.en: : Especially if you’re going to, like...try to see me more...and stuff.
lines.zh: : 尤其是如果你要……试着多见我……什么的。

lines.en: : You really suffered for me, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的为我受了不少苦，是吧？

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain23
: Not until you started fucking ignoring me, asshole. This whole “suffering” thing is still new to me.  And, I’ll tell you what, Sensei- I’m not cut out for it.
lines.zh: : 直到你他妈的开始不理我为止，混蛋。这个"受苦"对我来说还是新鲜事。而且我告诉你啊，Sensei——我不是干这行的料。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve got bad news for you then. Because-
lines.zh: : 那我有个坏消息要告诉你。因为——

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain24

: {size=-1}Yeah, whatever. Before you start with that whole “just being with me is suffering” nonsense, let me remind you that you’ve been saying that forever and it has literally never been an issue.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}行吧，随便。在你开始那套"跟我在一起就是受苦"的废话之前，让我提醒你，你从很久以前就这么说了，而且从来、从来都不是什么问题。{/size}

lines.en: : Unless you’ve, like...{i}actually{/i} been cheating on me this entire time and were just really good at hiding it. But I’m pretty sure that’s, like a...{i}your{/i} world thing.
lines.zh: : 除非你……{i}其实{/i}一直都在背着我偷情，而且藏得特别好。不过我挺确定那是……{i}你的{/i}世界那边的事。

lines.en: : Wait, so...you’re conceding that this world is {i}my{/i} world? That you’re not supposed to be here?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以……你承认这个世界是{i}我的{/i}世界了？承认你本来不该在这儿？

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain25
: Now- I didn’t say that I’m not supposed to be here. But with all of the weird shit that’s been happening and everything I’ve heard from you {i}and{/i} Ayane?
lines.zh: : 喏——我没说我本来不该在这儿。可是出了这么多奇怪的事，再加上我从你{i}和{/i} Ayane 那儿听到的一切？

lines.en: : It’s pretty much impossible to convince myself at this point that the world is what I thought it was.
lines.zh: : 到这个地步，我基本不可能再说服自己，这个世界就是我以为的那个样子。

lines.en: : You should applaud me for how perceptive and smart I am now.
lines.zh: : 你该为我现在这么敏锐、这么聪明而给我鼓掌。

lines.en: : Sorry...it’s just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……只是……

lines.en: : It’s weird that you can...{i}know{/i} this much despite not having been to the rooftop with us.
lines.zh: : 你能{i}知道{/i}这么多，真的很奇怪，尽管你从没跟我们一起上过天台。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t have retained any of that, Maya. Everything Ayane and I told you should have been purged after Halloween.
lines.zh: : 你不该保留下那些的，Maya。我和 Ayane 告诉过你的一切，在万圣节之后本该被清除掉。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain26
: Ugh. I wish it {i}was.{/i} Everything’s so...weird now. And...scary.
lines.zh: : 唔。我也希望{i}是{/i}。现在一切都好……奇怪。而且……可怕。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain27
: But I...care less about that right now and...more about just getting {i}you{/i} back.
lines.zh: : 但我……现在不那么在意那个，更在意的是……把{i}你{/i}找回来。

lines.en: : Because {i}you{/i} are my coping mechanism, Sensei. {i}You{/i} are the box I’ve stored all of my feelings in. And there’s not a chance in hell I could confront any of this without you.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}是我的应对机制，Sensei。{i}你{/i}是我把所有感情都塞进去的那只盒子。要是没有你，我绝对不可能去面对这一切。

lines.en: : You...want to confront it then?
lines.zh: : 你……想面对它？

lines.en: : Well, to be fair, I still don’t really know what it {i}is{/i} we’re confronting. But yes. Whatever it is, I want to do it with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说句公道话，我其实还不太清楚我们要面对的{i}到底{/i}是什么。但是的。不管是什么，我想跟你一起做。

lines.en: : I’m just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain28
: All this...paranormal stuff if...that’s what you want to call it...
lines.zh: : 所有这种……超自然的东西，如果……你非要这么叫的话……

lines.en: : It’s all making me feel less...{i}permanent{/i} than I want to feel.
lines.zh: : 它们都在让我觉得自己没那么……{i}恒久{/i}，没那么像我想要的那样恒久。

lines.en: : Like...what if I {i}do{/i} get to keep going? What if you fall back in love with {i}me?{/i} And everything’s normal and good again and you stop sleeping with other girls.
lines.zh: : 比如……要是我{i}真的{/i}能继续走下去呢？要是你重新爱上{i}我{/i}呢？要是一切都恢复正常、重新变好，你也不再跟别的女孩上床了呢？

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : Shut up. I’m not done.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我还没说完。

lines.en: : What if all of that happens and you lose me {i}again?{/i} Or I lose {i}you?{/i} Or we {i}both{/i} get lost somehow? Or, even worse, what if you {i}never{/i} stop sleeping with other girls?
lines.zh: : 要是这一切都发生了，然后你{i}又{/i}失去我了呢？或者我失去{i}你{/i}？或者我们{i}两个都{/i}走丢了？或者更糟，要是你{i}永远{/i}都不停止跟别的女孩上床呢？

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : Again, shut up. You seriously need to stop interrupting me. And also sleeping with other girls.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，闭嘴。你真该改改打断我的毛病。另外也该改改跟别的女孩上床的毛病。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain29
: Oh. If you can’t tell, I’m also really annoyed that you keep sleeping with other girls.
lines.zh: : 哦。如果你看不出来的话，我也真的很烦你一直跟别的女孩上床。

lines.en: : I...had a feeling.
lines.zh: : 我……有感觉。

lines.en: : Point is, Sensei...there’s still so much I don’t know. And I don’t want you to put too much faith into me {i}getting it{/i} just because I’ve gotten it in the past or...future?
lines.zh: : 重点是，Sensei……我不知道的事还是太多了。我不想你因为我过去或未来"懂过"，就对我这次也{i}能懂{/i}抱太大信心。

lines.en: : I don’t know where...{i}your{/i} me is from on a technical level. But it kind of sounds like both in a way?
lines.zh: : 我不知道{i}你的{/i}那个我从技术上说来自哪里。但听起来好像……两方面都有点？

lines.en: : I think it kind of {i}is{/i} both in a way. Because she existed before you chronologically, but then obviously lasted {i}way{/i} longer than you have.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}确实{/i}两方面都有点。因为从时间顺序上说她在你之前就存在，但显然又比你活得久{i}得多{/i}。

lines.en: : What do you think was happening with my consciousness in the meantime then?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得这中间我的意识去哪儿了？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but...I imagine the other Maya would have come up with something about timelines or...yeah. You were probably just...somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过……我想换作另一个 Maya，她会说出点关于时间线的东西，或者……是啊。你大概只是……在别的什么地方。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain30
: ...Somewhere else, huh?
lines.zh: : ……别的什么地方，是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...or something like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……大概是那样。

lines.en: : Has that...ever happened to you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那种事……在你身上发生过吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Have you ever just...been somewhere else all of a sudden? Or maybe...some...{i}when{/i} else?...
lines.zh: : 你有没有突然就……在别的什么地方？或者也许……在别的什么"{i}时候{/i}"？……

lines.en: scene amisfunpartynight4
scene amisfunpartynight39
scene makotosekai33
scene okayitsgametimeagain1
scene mayatakoagain30
: Probably...yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概……有过。

lines.en: : It’s kind of...hard to remember, though. Like...it seems like it’s {i}there{/i} but...fuzzy.
lines.zh: : 只是……有点难回想起来。像……它好像就在{i}那儿{/i}，但……模糊。

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} to remember? Or do you think everything would just get even {i}more{/i} confusing if you did?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}记起来吗？还是说，记起来只会让一切变得{i}更{/i}混乱？

lines.en: : Everything always gets more confusing here. That’s just the way this world works, I think.
lines.zh: : 在这里，事情永远只会变得更混乱。我觉得这个世界就是这么运转的。

lines.en: : That’s another thing I’m afraid of. Because I know you’re hoping somewhere deep down that {i}I{/i} will remember things that happened with the me who isn’t me.
lines.zh: : 这也是{i}我{/i}害怕的另一点。因为我知道你内心深处某个地方在盼着我能记起跟那个不是我的我之间发生的事。

lines.en: : And while I know that might feel real to you...for me, I...
lines.zh: : 虽然我知道那对你来说可能很真实……但对我来说，我……

lines.en: : Well...
: You know...I often wish I didn’t have to remember Sekai.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我经常希望自己不必记得 Sekai。

lines.en: : Well, duh. That’s basically the only reason we’re together.
lines.zh: : 废话。那基本上是我们在一起的唯一原因。

lines.en: : But I often {i}also{/i} think that one day, remembering her might actually be {i}good.{/i} And I might become stronger for it.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}也{/i}常常在想，也许有一天，记得她其实是件{i}好事{/i}。也许我会因此变得更坚强。

lines.en: scene mayatakoagain31
: HA! No you don’t, you fucking liar! The day you’re that optimistic about anything is the day I give up watermelon.
lines.zh: : 哈！才不会呢，你这个骗人的混蛋！你要是哪天对什么事这么乐观了，那就是我戒掉西瓜的日子。

lines.en: : Heh...you’re right.
lines.zh: : 嘿……你说得对。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Wouldn’t it be nice if you weren’t, though?
lines.zh: : 可要是你错了，那该多好啊？

lines.en: : Yeah. But I think there are a lot of things out there that {i}would{/i} be nice. And that chances are, we won’t ever get to see or experience the vast majority of them.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但我想这世上有很多事{i}会{/i}是美好的。而且很可能在绝大多数事情上，我们永远都看不到、也体验不到。

lines.en: : Well hey, that’s {i}one{/i} potential perk of an infinite life if we’re able to hang on. We might {i}actually{/i} get to see...{i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿，不过这也许就是永生的{i}一个{/i}潜在好处，只要我们撑得住。我们说不定{i}真{/i}能看见……{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 是啊……也许吧。

lines.en: : But {i}then{/i} what?...
lines.zh: : 可{i}然后{/i}呢？……

lines.en: : What else is there to see when we’ve already seen everything? What else is there to {i}do{/i} when we’ve already done it all?
lines.zh: : 当我们已经看见了一切，还有什么可看的？当我们已经做尽了一切，还有什么{i}可做的{/i}？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} the end of the world?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是世界的尽头吗？

lines.en: : Is that what {i}she{/i} saw?
lines.zh: : 那就是{i}她{/i}看见的东西吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so...
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为……

lines.en: scene black
: The end of the world is a little more colorful than that.
lines.zh: : 世界的尽头可比那个五彩缤纷一点。

lines.en: There’s a hand to my side that doesn’t belong to me.
lines.zh: 我身侧有一只不属于我的手。

lines.en: But when it reaches for something that {i}does{/i} — a cardboard boat of fried octopus that is likely only {i}somewhat{/i} scorching now — I do something.
lines.zh: 但当它伸向某样{i}属于{/i}我的东西——一纸船的炸章鱼，现在大概只是{i}有点{/i}烫——我做了点什么。

lines.en: I grab it.
lines.zh: 我抓住了它。

lines.en: Her hand — not the takoyaki.
lines.zh: 她的手——不是章鱼烧。

lines.en: And when I grab it, there’s this...pause.
lines.zh: 而当我抓住它的时候，出现了一种……停顿。

lines.en: Silence.
lines.zh: 沉默。

lines.en: She stares down at our hands for a moment, the same as me, and my mind once again gravitates to the size disparity between the two.
lines.zh: 她低头盯着我们俩的手看了一会儿，我也一样，我的思绪又一次被两者之间的尺寸差距吸引过去。

lines.en: But then she tilts her head up and her eyes meet mine.
lines.zh: 但接着她抬起头，目光对上了我的眼睛。

lines.en: And we just sit there for a full minute looking at each other.
lines.zh: 我们就这么坐着，整整一分钟，看着彼此。

lines.en: We aren’t smiling. We aren’t speaking.
lines.zh: 我们没有笑。没有说话。

lines.en: We’re just...connecting.
lines.zh: 我们只是……相连着。

lines.en: And it’s the most unfaithful I have ever felt.
lines.zh: 而这是我有史以来感觉最不忠的一刻。
